reason: A migration and import plugin that scans local agent-tool data and copies sessions, memories, skills, instructions, and commands into DeepSeek Harness with resumable imports and approval-gated writes.

summaries.zh: 将 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 和 Hermes 的会话及相关上下文扫描并复制到 DeepSeek Harness 中，支持可恢复导入、增量同步和审批控制。
summaries.en: Scans and copies sessions and related context from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Hermes into DeepSeek Harness with resumable imports, incremental synchronization, and approval-gated writes.

capabilities: Read local Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Hermes data files
Parse and import session transcripts, memories, skills, instructions, and slash commands
Write migrated sessions, workspace data, cache state, and managed instruction sections
Probe project Git state when configured
Expose a web migration panel and API routes
